new_statements.quote: Stress regularly falls on the penultimate syllable, paragogic vowels not counted (see 2.3). Words with a sequence of like vowels in the antepenultimate and penultimate syllables receive stress on the antepenultimate mora (see the example of maata above). Enclitics and suffixes lead to stress shift to the right, as e.g. in bolé-ku 'my house' (house-1s.GEN) or noitamó=lon 'already arrived' (PV.ST:PST:arrive=CPL)

new_statements.rule_in_words: Word stress is fixed on the penultimate syllable of the word, where the word excludes the paragogic (echo) vowel that follows a root-final consonant (buok+u 'hair' etc.). A sequence of identical vowels in the antepenult+penult is stressed on its first mora (maata), i.e. a long vowel counts as one heavy penult (Wikipedia paraphrases this as 'a sequence of like vowels counts as one syllable'). Stress is recomputed on the suffixed/cliticised word, so suffixes and enclitics shift stress rightward (bolé-ku, noitamó=lon); when a suffix or enclitic is added the paragogic vowel is dropped and stress is regular penult.
new_statements.secondary_stress: Not mentioned in the snippets retrieved.
new_statements.exceptions: Paragogic vowels are extrametrical (not counted); like-vowel sequences across antepenult/penult take stress on the antepenultimate mora; enclitics and suffixes shift stress to the right. The 2010 Survey (citing Sneddon & Usup 1986: 418) adds that the paragogic vowel is being lost in Buol, which yields regular penult stress.
new_statements.domain_note: Phonological word including suffixes and enclitics (stress shifts with them); paragogic vowel excluded from the count. Citation-form vs phrase-level behaviour not discussed in the snippets.
new_statements.identity_note: Zobel 2005 describes Buol proper (apadu Vuolo, Kabupaten Buol, c. 75,000 speakers per Grimes 1996) = buol1237; no dialect is singled out. Access caveat: the deciding sentences come from Google Books full-text search snippets of the Routledge chapter (three overlapping snippets reconstruct the passage word for word), not from an open PDF or a held scan; the feed exposes no page number. The full chapter remains paywalled; if a stricter standard is required, downgrade to description-exists-not-accessible and keep the quote as provisional.
